name: app-starter
//: Dependencies are declared as RANGES and deliberately NOT pinned: this starter is a SHAPE, not a lockfile. Declaring them at all is what makes `npm install` produce a toolchain, so G5-G8 (types, lint, unit, functional) can RUN - with none declared they were BLOCKED in every environment, including CI, and were for 28 consecutive gate runs. Each name was verified against the registry before being written here (RC-011). When you scaffold: install, verify each package is the intended one, and commit the lockfile.
